title: Twitch Drops
headline: Twitch Drops
subtitle: Watch nopixel V This Weekend to Get the Grotti Turismo Omaggio and Rockstar Motorsport Livery
content:
We are proud to support nopixel — who continually push the boundaries of GTA Roleplay.

Link your Twitch and Rockstar Games accounts and watch select streamers in nopixel V, a GTAV Roleplay experience on Twitch, through November 1 and earn the Grotti Turismo Omaggio and Rockstar Motorsport livery.

Visit https://www.rockstargames.com/gta-online/twitch-drops to learn more.
